exposure: causes of death (e.g., hemorrhage, COVID-19 complications)
cohort: The study included all maternal deaths reported to the Tunis Regional Health Directorate between January 2017 and December 2023.
finding: The average Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) was 46.88 per 100,000 live births, with hemorrhage (20.8%) and COVID-19 complications (16.6%) being the main causes of death, and most deaths (83.33%) occurring in the postpartum period.
